project: Adaptive Meal Preparation in a Campus Canteen using Q-Learning
synthetic_simulation_notice: Demand profiles, outlook probabilities, forecast accuracy, carryover fraction, and reward weights are illustrative assumptions, not measured campus data.
state_representation: time slot, exact inventory, noisy observed forecast, cumulative sales pace category (below/on-track/above expected), and whether any earlier slot had a stockout; true daily regime is hidden

sales_history_features.classification: Cumulative sales in completed slots divided by cumulative expected demand under the Bayesian forecast estimate; below 0.85 is below expected, above 1.15 is above expected, otherwise on track. Before the first slot it is on track.
sales_history_features.prior_stockout_flag: True if any earlier slot had unmet demand; this helps distinguish censored sales from a low-demand signal.
sales_history_features.limitation: These are compact observation summaries, not a full Bayesian belief state; the process remains partially observable.

forecast_model.wrong_forecast_rule: If the forecast is wrong, one of the other outlook categories is selected uniformly.
forecast_model.baseline_demand_estimate: Posterior expected demand multiplier given the observed forecast, using Bayes' rule.

forecast_observation_model: True regime is sampled from the configured prior. The forecast is correct with the configured probability; on an error, one of the other categories is chosen uniformly.
baseline_forecast_interpretation: The rule-based baseline uses the Bayesian posterior forecast estimate and the same sales-pace/prior-stockout signals as Q-learning, with its target and correction tuned on a separate validation set.

q_learning_hyperparameter_tuning.purpose: Screen a four-candidate learning-rate/epsilon-decay grid on a two-seed validation sweep before final test evaluation.

validation_tuning.purpose: Select forecast-aware rule target and sales-history correction on validation scenarios separate from final test episodes.

multi_seed_robustness.description: Mean and SD across independently trained Q-learning agents; each was tested on the same held-out synthetic days.

demand_shift_stress_test.description: Seed-2026 Q-table and rule-based baselines evaluated on 1,000 episodes per scenario. Demand means scale in the environment, while both the Q-table and the tuned schedule's planning demand means remain nominal; this tests deployment shift without giving the baseline the changed demand means.
